describe.description: The creature is a quadrupedal mammal shown in right-facing profile with the overall body, fur, head, limbs and proportions of a brown bear but with beetle features integrated into its back and forehead. It has thick shaggy brown fur with lighter tan on the muzzle and underbelly, four sturdy legs ending in clawed paws, a small rounded tail at the rear, and two small rounded ears on top of the head. A large glossy dark brown hardened shell covers the entire dorsal back from the shoulders to the rump, and a single long curved glossy dark brown horn projects upward and backward from the center of the forehead. A row of small oval dark openings is visible in the fur along the side of the torso just below the edge of the shell.
